Nathan Brooks  
Email: nbrooks@veridian.com | Phone: (555) 123-4567 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/nbrooks | GitHub: github.com/nbrooks  

As a Security Engineer at Veridian Dynamics, I specialize in designing and maintaining robust security frameworks for enterprise-scale systems. My work focuses on integrating proactive defense mechanisms with continuous compliance oversight to mitigate risks across distributed infrastructures. Over the past three years, I’ve led initiatives that reduced critical vulnerabilities by 35% and streamlined incident response workflows, improving team efficiency by 22%. My approach combines technical rigor with a deep understanding of regulatory requirements, ensuring solutions align with both business objectives and security mandates.  

At Veridian Dynamics, I spearheaded the migration of legacy authentication systems to a multi-factor IAM architecture, reducing unauthorized access attempts by 40% within six months. This involved designing custom access control policies, integrating with existing SSO platforms, and collaborating with DevOps teams to automate provisioning. I also played a key role in the SOC2 audit process, drafting documentation to meet compliance standards and coordinating with third-party auditors to address gaps. My work on encryption protocols included implementing AES-256 for data-at-rest and managing PKI infrastructure to support secure API communications.  

Prior to joining Veridian, I served as a Security Analyst at NetShield Corp, where I conducted regular penetration tests to identify misconfigurations in firewall rules and network segmentation strategies. This led to the implementation of a dynamic firewall policy framework, which reduced false positives by 30% and improved threat detection rates. I also managed vulnerability scanning tools, prioritizing critical risks and developing remediation playbooks that cut remediation time by 15%. My focus on compliance extended to GDPR data protection assessments, where I helped establish data minimization practices and audit trails for user activity.  

In my role as a Junior Security Engineer at SecureLink Technologies, I contributed to the development of a SIEM-based incident detection system using Splunk, which enabled real-time monitoring of 12,000+ endpoints. This involved configuring correlation rules, integrating with endpoint detection tools, and refining alert triage processes. I also supported the deployment of endpoint encryption across the organization, ensuring compliance with internal security policies and industry standards.  

Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity, Purdue University (2021)  
Fluent in English; intermediate proficiency in Spanish  
Certifications: CISSP, CISA, CompTIA Security+  
Awarded “Top Contributor” for optimizing vulnerability management processes at NetShield Corp (2022)  
Recognized for leading the SOC2 compliance initiative at Veridian Dynamics, resulting in a 100% audit clearance (2023)
